steps.text: Log in to the mobile application
Navigate to the main dashboard and select the 'E-Voucher' section by tapping the icon.
Browse available categories such as Home & Kitchen, Electronics & Mobile, etc.
Select a category to view vouchers within it.

Filtering Options: 
 1. Tap the filter icon at the bottom right corner. 
 2. Adjust the filter options: 
 o Category: Choose the desired category. 
 o Region: Select your preferred region. 
 o Min/Max Value: Set the price range. 
 3. Tap Search to view filtered results.

Selecting and Customizing the Voucher : 
 1. Browse the displayed vouchers.
  2. Tap on the desired voucher (e.g., PlayStation). 
 3. Select the region and voucher amount (e.g., 5 USD for the United States). 
 4. Tap Next to proceed.

Confirming the Purchase 
 1. Review the voucher details: ( - Voucher Name ,  - Amount , - Region ) 
  2. Tap Purchase Now to proceed to payment.

Payment Process : 
 1. Choose a payment method: - Select the account you wish to pay from. 
 2. Confirm the selection and tap Next.

Verification : 
  1. Enter the 6-digit verification code sent to your registered mobile number. 
 2. Tap Next to complete the verification.

Purchase Confirmation: 
 1. View the confirmation details, including: ( Voucher Name , Amount , Region , Reference Number ) 
 2. Tap Back to Dashboard or View Voucher Details.

Viewing and Sharing the Voucher 
 1. Review the voucher details on the 'Voucher Details' screen: ( Gift Card Claim Code , PIN ) 
 2. Tap Share Voucher to send the details if needed.

• Ensure all selections (region, value) are accurate before proceeding. 
 • Refunds and exchanges are subject to the stated policies in the Terms & Conditions.
